Dynamic-tree surface-area cache: full-world comparison (guarded refits; not adopted)
Date:                       2026-09-16
Branch:                     experiment/dynamic-aabb-tree
Uncached source:            ddfc6a5
Cached source:              ddfc6a5 + uncommitted guarded double-precision area cache
Build:                      Release, Apple Clang 17.0.0.17000604, arm64, -O3 -DNDEBUG
Hardware:                   Apple M2, macOS
Command per binary:         phys_collision_bench 10 tree
Workload:                   Seeded sphere field (seed 42), 120 Hz, no warmup
Samples per run:            10 through 2500 bodies; 100 at 5000; 25 at 10000
Protocol:                   Three sequential/interleaved runs per version
Summary:                    Median of each metric's three per-run means; maintenance and cold construction included
Change:                     Cache fat-bound area beside bounds; reuse in traversal and insertion costs
Invalidation:               Refresh on creation, reinsertion, and refits that actually change fat bounds
                            Height is still updated on every refit
Node size:                  88 bytes uncached; 96 bytes cached
Unchanged:                  IDs, margins, geometry, topology heuristics, traversal, output ordering, allocation policy
Notes:                      Earlier eager-refit cache results are retained separately.
                            Short-run timing differences on a shared machine are not statistically conclusive.

Execution order: uncached-1, cached-1, cached-2, uncached-2, uncached-3, cached-3
Pair counts, traversal counts, heights, proxy maintenance counts, and allocations match exactly.
